raised: The pension's '1.47% מההפקדות' looks big, and nothing says what it means in shekels
The fees are shown as 'ממוצע 2025' (Harel's 2025 average), not what I pay; unclear whether my own deal differs
The '123 מקבוץ · 123 מחושב' line is confusing
Product names are unclear: 'תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים', 'מרכזית לפיצויים', and which of 'מקיפה' or 'כללית' is mine
Not sure whether 'קרן השתלמות' is relevant at my age
The 'PF-06'/'PF-10' codes in the footnotes mean nothing
Index-tracking and exchange-traded funds show three fees (קבוע/משתנה/נאמן) with no total
Jargon labels such as 'צוברת', 'מס גם על שינויי המטבע' and 'כמה דרכים יחד'
The closed 'מה כתוב במסמכים' sections give no hint of what's inside
'אין' in the fee column first looked like 'no information'
'עוד לא דווח' with its warning mark was confusing
Unclear what the arrows at the end of each row and the sort arrows open
Dotted underlines under numbers suggest clicking, but it's unclear why
Unclear which is worse, the fee on deposits or the fee on savings, and why the pension charges both
'4A', '4D' and 'מנוטרלת מט"ח' not understood
Direct costs ('הוצאות ישירות') come out of the fund but aren't shown; how much are they?
No returns after fees
No way to tell which product and track I'm in, or how to switch and what switching costs
No sign of the best fee I could ask for, only the average
No comparison with other companies; nothing points to the 'השוואה למטרה' link
No information on what each product pays out at retirement
Would drop the coloured rings
Would drop the 'חיסכון לכל ילד' and 'מרכזית לפיצויים' sections

problems.why: The column head reads 'דמי ניהול לפי …'. The reader's confusion over what the 'ממוצע 2025' basis means (Harel's average versus what they actually pay) is a clear part of that head not being explained.
